description: Whether a coordinate lies inside a polygon: delivery zones, catchments, congestion or clean-air zones, site boundaries. Provide `point` {lat, lon} and `polygon` as 3+ {lat, lon} coordinates of the outer ring (closed automatically if the last does not repeat the first). Points exactly on the boundary count as OUTSIDE. Local computation: no network call, no quota.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

polygon.description:
The polygon's outer ring, 3 or more coordinates. Closed
automatically if the last point does not repeat the first.

name: geo_point_in_polygon

inside.description:
True when the point is strictly inside the ring. Points exactly on
the boundary are **not** counted as inside.
